# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)

# Calculate mean
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(v - mean) for v in values]
print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"Absolute deviations: {abs_deviations}")

# Calculate MAD
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / n
print(f"\nMAD: {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
